_meta.name: demo_lexicon_v1
_meta.status: DEMO resource: written by the project assistant, NOT reviewed by a linguist or educator, small and general-purpose. Glosses are plain-language approximations. Replace with a reviewed lexicon before any study.

catalyst.gloss: a substance that makes a reaction go faster

photosynthesis.gloss: how plants use sunlight to make their food

hypothesis.gloss: an idea that can be tested

phenomenon.gloss: something that happens and can be observed

ambiguous.gloss: having more than one possible meaning

osmosis.gloss: the movement of water through a thin barrier

mitochondria.gloss: the parts of a cell that release energy

enzyme.gloss: a protein that speeds up reactions in living things

ecosystem.gloss: a community of living things and their surroundings

metabolism.gloss: the chemical reactions that keep a living thing alive

correlation.gloss: a link between two things that change together

democracy.gloss: a system where people choose their leaders by voting

algorithm.gloss: a set of steps for solving a problem

equilibrium.gloss: a steady state where things are balanced

hereditary.gloss: passed on from parents to children

substrate.gloss: the material an enzyme works on

evaporation.gloss: when a liquid slowly turns into a gas

condensation.gloss: when a gas cools and turns into liquid

friction.gloss: the force that slows things that rub together
